criterion: M3 criterion 2 and dated addition 8 (GTAO, SSR, TAA): every run against evidence/m3-post-bounds.json, failures included

runs.what: test_post --json --models: test scene, near camera, Suzanne, helmet role
runs.result: fail. GTAO within its error bounds (mean 0.008 to 0.021) but three scenes miss coverage, and there the control (visibility 1) also meets the bounds; on Suzanne GTAO is further from the reference than the control. An open plane reads up to 0.086 away from 1. SSR 69% to 87% correct against 90%, the rest nearly all misses; the unlimited-thickness control does not discriminate (0.01% to 5.3% false hits).
runs.action: method note 2: diagnosis (GTAO samples off the slice plane; SSR steps mostly off screen), fixes, a fifth scene, coverage gating, SSR control (c)

runs.result: fail: GTAO is gated on one scene only (the near scene: mean 0.0075, p95 0.025, control fails), against the two-scene gate; on the other four GTAO is still further from the reference than visibility 1. SSR passes on its two gated scenes (98.3%, 96.5%; false hits 0.2%, 0.5%; control (c) 0%); ungated: Suzanne 94.3%, helmet 84.4%, interior 65.1%. Open plane 0.081.
runs.action: method note 3: two plane biases found (screen-uniform slices; nearest-pixel sample depth), fixed; a procedure for a coverage scene

runs.what: after notes 3 and 4, six scenes (adds the interior close-up chosen by reference-only coverage)
runs.result: fail on the interior close-up, the only scene with dense occlusion. GTAO there: mean 0.104 (bound 0.05), p95 0.458 (bound 0.15); the control is worse (0.216, 0.585). SSR there: 80.3% correct (bound 90%), false hits 17.6% (bound 10%). On the open scenes the plane fixes cut GTAO's error about tenfold (mean 0.0017 to 0.0084, now below the control on every scene), and GTAO passes on the near scene (mean 0.0034, p95 0.016). SSR passes on the test scene and the near scene. The open plane still reads up to 0.077 from 1 at its worst pixel. Inferred causes on the close-up: GTAO treats every visible surface as infinitely thick, so pieces in front darken what lies behind them, and a 0.5-unit radius spans hundreds of pixels at 16 steps; SSR cannot see the hidden sides of the pieces.

status: GTAO and SSR fail their bounds on the interior close-up. Not loosened. A thickness heuristic for GTAO and SSR is the next candidate change, to be described in a method note before it runs.
